title: The daily diagnostics time a fresh repository from connect to first merge
description: Running the onboarding diagnostic once starts a scratch install on its own Postgres, connects a fixture repository and a stub Builder, starts the first task as the first-run page does, merges it, and master status's batch gate shows the run's first-merge minutes, result and date. A run over 15 minutes or needing a hand fix files an item.

steps.name: run the onboarding diagnostic once and read its first-merge time in master status
